data.description:
A folder (previously called a project) is a container in which to organize media into. It can be
used to set permissions that apply to all the media in the folder as well as
organizing media into subfolders (previously called media groups).

created.description: The date that the folder was originally created.

cursor.description: A cursor for stable pagination based on current `sort_by` order. You can pass this to `cursor[before]` or `cursor[after]` as a parameter to fetch the records before or after this record in the same sort order. This is only populated if records were fetched with `cursor[enabled]`, or `cursor[before]` or `cursor[after]`.

hashed_id.description: A private hashed id, uniquely identifying the folder within the system.

id.description: A unique numeric identifier for the folder within the system.

kind.description:
Indicates the folder's access scope, relative to the requesting user. One of:
- `library`: a library the requester owns. Libraries can still be shared with specific contacts or contact groups; the only restriction is that they cannot be shared with the whole account.
- `shared`: a folder the requester has access to via a Contact or ContactGroup sharing — this includes both shared folders and another contact's library that the requester has been granted access to.
- `account`: a folder shared with the whole account (everyone in the company can see it).

media_count.description: The number of different medias that have been uploaded to the folder.

medias.description: A link to where you can fetch the medias for this folder.

url.description: A URL for fetching all child records of the parent record.

name.description: The folder’s display name.

personal_library.description: Whether this folder is someone's personal library ("My Library"). Unlike `kind`, this is a property of the folder itself and does not depend on who is requesting — it is `true` for a personal library even when that library has been shared with you (where `kind` would read `shared`). Use this, not `kind`, to tell whether a folder is a personal library.

public.description: A boolean indicating whether the folder is available for public (anonymous) viewing.

public_id.description: If the folder is public, this field contains a string representing the ID used for referencing the folder in public URLs.

updated.description: The date that the folder was last updated.

data.description:
An account represents a customer at Wistia. Each account can own media, folders
channels, etc.

channel_count.description: The total number of channels in this account

folder_count.description: The total number of folders in this account

media_count.description: The total number of medias in this account

name.description: Account name

data.description:
Account usage and plan information, including storage, media, seat, and bandwidth limits.
Fields under `limits` are only visible to account owners and managers.

can_invite_teammates.description:
Whether the authenticated contact can invite additional teammates via the
modern contacts endpoint. True when the contact is an owner or manager and
the account has a verified business domain.

can_upload.description: Whether the next upload will succeed. False when an inflexible media or storage limit has been reached.

limits.description:
Usage and limit data. Null when the authenticated contact does not have
billing visibility (i.e. is not an account owner or manager).

bandwidth.description: Bandwidth usage and limits for the current billing period, in bytes (1 GB = 1,000,000,000 bytes)

limit_bytes.description: Bandwidth limit for the billing period in bytes. Null if unlimited.

period.description: Whether the bandwidth allowance is tracked monthly or annually

resets_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the bandwidth period resets, or null if unknown

used_bytes.description: Bandwidth used in the current billing period, in bytes

count.description: Current number of media in the account

flexible_limit.description: Soft media limit (overage billed). Null if no soft limit.

inflexible_limit.description: Hard media limit (uploads blocked). Null if no hard limit.

primary_resource.description: The primary resource type for this plan's limits — "storage" for standard plans, "media" for legacy plans

storage.description: Storage usage and limits in bytes (1 GB = 1,000,000,000 bytes)

flexible_limit_bytes.description: Included storage limit in bytes. Null if unlimited.

inflexible_limit_bytes.description: Hard storage cap in bytes. Null if no hard cap.

users.description: Seat (user) usage and limits. Viewers are non-billable and excluded from the billable counts.

account_billable_count.description:
Billable users in this account only, the count compared against `inflexible_limit`
when enforcing the hard seat limit. Matches `billable_count` for non-agency accounts.
Excludes viewers.

billable_count.description:
Current number of billable users (seats). For agency accounts this aggregates
distinct users across the parent and team accounts — the count billing compares
against `flexible_limit`. Excludes viewers.

flexible_limit.description: Included seats on flexible plans (additional seats billed as overage). Null if no soft limit.

inflexible_limit.description: Hard seat limit (adding users blocked at the limit). Null if no hard limit.

viewers_count.description: Current number of viewer contacts, which are non-billable and don't count toward seat limits.

links.description: URLs for plan, usage, and billing pages

billing_url.description: URL to the account's billing page. Null for non-owner/manager contacts.

plans_url.description: URL to the account's plans page. Always present.

usage_url.description: URL to the account's usage page. Null for non-owner/manager contacts.

is_standard.description: Whether this is a 2026 storage-based plan (true) or a legacy media-count plan (false)

is_trial.description: Whether the account is currently on a trial

name.description: Human-readable plan name

tier.description:
The plan tier identifier. Common values include `free`, `starter`, `plus`,
`pro`, `advanced`, `business`, `enterprise`. Legacy plans may use other
tier names. Empty string if the account has no plan.

trial_expires_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the trial expires, or null if not trialing

role.description:
The authenticated contact's role on the account. One of `owner`, `manager`,
`standard_user`, `limited_user`, `viewer`. Null when the token isn't
associated with a specific contact.

upload_blocked_reason.description:
The reason uploads are blocked, or null if uploads are allowed.
Known values: `reached_media_limit`, `reached_storage_limit`.

verified_domain.description:
Whether the account has at least one verified business domain (i.e. an
owner whose email domain is verified and business-classified). Independent
of plan tier.

data.description:
A folder (previously called a project) is a container in which to organize media into. It can be
used to set permissions that apply to all the media in the folder as well as
organizing media into subfolders (previously called media groups).

created.description: The date that the folder was originally created.

cursor.description: A cursor for stable pagination based on current `sort_by` order. You can pass this to `cursor[before]` or `cursor[after]` as a parameter to fetch the records before or after this record in the same sort order. This is only populated if records were fetched with `cursor[enabled]`, or `cursor[before]` or `cursor[after]`.

hashed_id.description: A private hashed id, uniquely identifying the folder within the system.

id.description: A unique numeric identifier for the folder within the system.

kind.description:
Indicates the folder's access scope, relative to the requesting user. One of:
- `library`: a library the requester owns. Libraries can still be shared with specific contacts or contact groups; the only restriction is that they cannot be shared with the whole account.
- `shared`: a folder the requester has access to via a Contact or ContactGroup sharing — this includes both shared folders and another contact's library that the requester has been granted access to.
- `account`: a folder shared with the whole account (everyone in the company can see it).

media_count.description: The number of different medias that have been uploaded to the folder.

medias.description: A link to where you can fetch the medias for this folder.

url.description: A URL for fetching all child records of the parent record.

name.description: The folder’s display name.

personal_library.description: Whether this folder is someone's personal library ("My Library"). Unlike `kind`, this is a property of the folder itself and does not depend on who is requesting — it is `true` for a personal library even when that library has been shared with you (where `kind` would read `shared`). Use this, not `kind`, to tell whether a folder is a personal library.

public.description: A boolean indicating whether the folder is available for public (anonymous) viewing.

public_id.description: If the folder is public, this field contains a string representing the ID used for referencing the folder in public URLs.

updated.description: The date that the folder was last updated.

parameters.name: new_still_media_id

parameters.description:
Custom metadata field values to set, keyed by field key. Values take the
same shapes as the Set Custom Metadata Field Value endpoint; a null value
clears that field and omitted fields are untouched. Requires the custom
metadata feature on the account.
parameters.name: custom_metadata

schema.description:
Custom metadata field values to set, keyed by field key. Values take the
same shapes as the Set Custom Metadata Field Value endpoint; a null value
clears that field and omitted fields are untouched. Requires the custom
metadata feature on the account.

archived.description: Whether or not the media is archived, either true or false.

created.description: The date when the media was originally uploaded.

description.description: A description for the media which usually appears near the top of the sidebar on the media's page.

duration.description: Specifies the length (in seconds) for audio and video files. Specifies number of pages in the document. Omitted for other types of media.

embedCode.description: DEPRECATED: If you want to programmatically embed videos, follow the construct an embed code guide.

hashed_id.description: A unique alphanumeric identifier for this media.

id.description: A unique numeric identifier for the media within the system.

name.description: The display name of the media.

progress.description: A floating point value between 0 and 1 that indicates the progress of the processing for this file.

protected.description: Whether the media is protected (e.g. requires a password or other authentication to view). Null if the media is not protected.

section.description: The title of the section in which the media appears. This attribute is omitted if the media is not in a section (default).

status.description: Post upload processing status. - `queued`: the file is waiting in the queue to be processed. - `processing`: the file is actively being processed. - `ready`: the file has been fully processed and is ready for embedding and viewing. - `failed`: the file was unable to be processed (usually a format or size error).

name.description: The display name of the tag.

type.description: A string representing what type of media this is.

updated.description: The date when the media was last changed.

description: Manage Wistia media, folders and tags and read account usage.
